teaser: The reading list I send by email is the first page people see of this newsroom, so it now explains itself, shows what was read, and asks for an answer.
core_idea: A reading list from one person to another, built into emails by the agent behind agent@riskmandate.ai and sent by me, is the first page of the newsroom for most of the people who open it, so it has to work as a front page: it now opens as a letter, explains the newsroom, uses the screen, shows the reader what they have read from their own browser in five views, was reviewed by the Designer before shipping, and points at the next step, answers that come back signed as easily as the lists go out.

nodes.label: A reading list in a link
nodes.summary: Article numbers, two names and a note after the #, which the server never sees.

nodes.label: The agent builds the lists
nodes.summary: agent@riskmandate.ai picks the articles, builds and checks the link, and I send the email.

nodes.label: About twenty lists by 18 October
nodes.summary: Counted in the inbox agent's debrief, among 178 emails.

nodes.label: The first page they see
nodes.summary: People arrive from an email, not the front page, so the list must explain the newsroom.

nodes.label: A column of links
nodes.summary: The first version answered how to send a list, not what the reader needed to know.

nodes.label: A letter, not a list
nodes.summary: A dateline, the note signed, one line on what it holds and costs, and cards that use the screen.

nodes.label: The newsroom in four steps
nodes.summary: Read, come back, keep the list, reply: a side column for first-time readers.

nodes.label: What you have read, shown
nodes.summary: A ring, section bars and done, later, not for me, from the reader's own browser.

nodes.label: Nothing is sent anywhere
nodes.summary: The page reads what the browser already holds; the newsroom keeps no record of opens.

nodes.label: Five views of one list
nodes.summary: Cards, headlines, sections, pictures and the list as a graph.

nodes.label: The Designer's fourteen findings
nodes.summary: A review on a real list at two widths, all fixed before release.

nodes.label: Pages that people use must keep up
nodes.summary: The page for publishers first, the reading list second.

nodes.label: Answers that come back signed
nodes.summary: Notes from the page reaching me and the agent, signed with keys from pki.sgit.ai.

quotes.text: What I had not thought through is who opens these links.
quotes.why: The turn of the article: the list was built for the sender and is read by people new to the newsroom.

quotes.text: The lists go out easily now. The answers do not come back as easily.
quotes.why: Where things stand, and the next step.
